item.title: Inside Brazil’s Plan to Integrate Pre-Salt Gas and Diversify Supply | OilPrice.com
item.description: Brazil is strategically upgrading its national gas pipeline infrastructure, led by operators TAG, NTS, and TBG, to manage declining Bolivian imports and integrate rising domestic pre-salt gas, LNG, and potential Argentine supplies.

item.title: The Hidden Energy Costs of Artificial Intelligence | OilPrice.com
item.description: Uncertainty over artificial intelligence’s true energy consumption is driving governments and companies to overinvest in new power capacity—often fossil-based—while obscuring the industry-driven roots of AI’s growing environmental impact.

item.title: Egypt Bets Big on Renewables as Foreign Investment Accelerates | OilPrice.com
item.description: Egypt is accelerating its renewable energy transition through major foreign-backed solar, storage, and hydrogen projects, but long-term success will depend on policy clarity and sustained international investment.

item.title: Inside Brazil’s Race to Secure Gas Supply | OilPrice.com
item.description: Brazil’s gas transmission operators are accelerating pipeline, compression, storage, and LNG integration projects to manage declining imports, unlock new domestic supply, and rebalance flows between the Southeast and Northeast.

item.description: Cuba’s worsening energy crisis has intensified following the loss of Venezuelan oil supplies, forcing Havana to seek short-term relief from Mexico while confronting the need for long-term structural reform under mounting U.S. pressure.
